verdict.rationale: Extend offers a 'Studio and Evals' feature (extend-docs-18) suggesting users can run their own evals, and a community user attests to good accuracy over a year (extend-comm-1), but there is no published reproducible accuracy benchmark, no dataset, no methodology, and no third-party benchmark corroboration. missing for 10: published reproducible accuracy benchmarks/methodology, benchmark datasets, independent verification of accuracy claims, detailed documentation on how the Evals tool works for self-serve testing.
